operative_criterion.interpretation: Old counted spans are positive lower-bound source eligibility proofs, not exhaustive operative-line counts. feature_criterion.interpretation: Old two-feature evidence is a minimum eligibility proof and may not be exhaustive. Confirm at least three with exact source paths and line spans. Name matching and machine nominations alone are insufficient.

selection_plan.group_caps_apply_to: Accepted selected plus reserve candidates; a rejected candidate does not consume a group slot.
selection_plan.shortfall: Report insufficient stronger-source eligible candidates; do not lower thresholds automatically.
